entry_points.description: Main entry point for ESG scoring requests. Auto-detects offline/online mode.

entry_points.name: CrawlerAdapter
entry_points.description: Adapter between PipelineOrchestrator and MultiSourceCrawler APIs.

agents/crawler/crawler_adapter.py.rationale: Core adapter logic, critical for API translation

apps/pipeline_orchestrator.py.rationale: Modified for crawler init, but large file with existing coverage

apps/api/main.py.rationale: Routing logic critical, but existing /score endpoint already tested

tdd.enforcement: Fail if test file missing for CP file

rationale.cp_selection: Critical path focuses on code that enables service activation: adapter (new), orchestrator init (modified), API routing (modified). All other files are infrastructure/documentation/testing.
rationale.test_requirements: Each CP file requires dedicated test file with @pytest.mark.cp marker. Adapter requires 100% coverage due to greenfield implementation. Orchestrator and API require ≥85% coverage on modified sections.
rationale.exclusions: Docker configs excluded from CP (infrastructure, not logic). Context files excluded (documentation). Integration tests excluded (validation, not production code).
